title: Aspirin-free Strategy With Ticagrelor in Patients With a Myocardial Infarction Treated Medically Alone
official: Evaluation of an asPirin-free Strategy With ticAgrelor in patieNTs witH a Myocardial Infarction treatEd Medically alONe (PANTHEON)
summary: In patients with a myocardial infarction (MI) treated medically alone, the objective of the PANTHEON trial is to evaluate if ticagrelor monotherapy reduces bleeding events, without an increase in patient-oriented ischemic events, compared with standard dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) with aspirin and ticagrelor for 12 months.
